text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT SALE - The CCC said it bought 25,470 tonnes dark northern spring wheat for donation to Ghana for May shipment.
CORN TENDERS - Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group will tender on Thursday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of corn, traders said.

The CCC said it was tendering on April 22 for a total of up to 9,690 tonnes of U.S. corn for export to Kenya and Angola, May 5-31 shipment. The total comprised up to 5,000 tonnes for Angola and up to 4,690 tonnes for Kenya.
SORGHUM TENDER - The CCC said it would tender on April 22 for up to 5,000 tonnes of U.S. sorghum for export to Kenya, May 5-31 shipment.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey's state grain board will seek bids for an international tender on April 29 to export 100,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley.

WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq will tender on April 18 for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat, U.S. exporters said. The wheat will be slated for June arrival. Nearly 300,000 tonnes of wheat have arrived in Iraq under its Oil-for-Food deal with the United Nations, a Iraqi government newspaper said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Syria offered 50,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for June shipment. Bids were due April 15.

- CCC said it was seeking up to 7,220 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat, maximum moisture 13.5 percent, under the export program for Bosnia. The shipment period was set for May 7-31 and offers were due April 21.
RICE TENDERS - Costa Rica will be tendering on April 16 for 26,500 tonnes optional origin long grain rough rice or 18,000 tonnes long grain milled rice.
RICE TENDERS - South Korea is expected to hold a tender at the end of June to buy 77,000 tonnes of rice to meet its 1997 quota under the World Trade Organization, U.S. Agriculture officials said.

MARKET TALK - Argentine traders said Wednesday they were unsure if a rumored big sale of soybean meal to China had taken place. Replying to talk that China had taken up to 300,000 tonnes of South American soymeal, one trader said, "It's all rumors, there's nothing confirmed."
... Hong Kong grains traders said on Wednesday China had likely bought a large quantity of soybean meal, since the price levels were suitable for Chinese buyers.
... Thailand's two vegetable oil crushers were recently in the market seeking around 100,000 tonnes of soybeans, trader sources said.
... The Turkish state grain board barley offer could eventually go towards meeting part of Saudi Arabia's recent purchase of about 500,000 tonnes of feed barley, a senior grain official said.
